Contact actions: transfer, groups and SIM phonebook

Güven Phone Help Guide, version 2.0.22

Open the Contact actions menu at the top of the Contacts tab.

With Import contacts, choose a VCF file. The file is checked; new contacts, exact matches and contacts to review are shown separately. You can skip identical entries, merge suitable ones or add them as separate contacts. You also choose where the contacts are saved.

Export contacts exports all contacts, or the ones you select, to a VCF file.

In Contact groups, Create group sets up a group with a name and an account. Add member and Remove from group change its members.

Rename group and Delete group are here too; deleting a group does not delete its contacts. Hide this group hides the group only in Güven Phone.

SIM phonebook shows the entries on your SIM card. Copy to contacts, Copy from contacts and Copy to SIM copy entries; only one name and one number are copied and the original stays where it is.
